style_suffix: ISO 7001 public information safety sign pictogram, exactly like an emergency exit running-man sign. Bold solid flat silhouette shapes on a plain flat white background. Absolutely no gradients, no shading, no texture, no perspective, no facial features, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no border frame, no drop shadow. Extremely simplified geometric human figure with rounded joints, thick uniform mass, high contrast, instantly readable at 5 meters distance and still readable when shrunk to a thumbnail. Flat vector look, single centered subject, generous white margin.

panels.prompt: On a pure white background: a pictogram of a simplified black human figure standing upright and drinking from a tall cylindrical sports water bottle held vertically straight up against its mouth. The bottle is a plain solid blue cylinder with a small cap, held upright, NOT tilted sideways, NOT a wine bottle, NOT a beer bottle, no neck, no shoulders on the bottle. Three solid blue droplet shapes float beside the figure. In the upper right corner a small solid black sun symbol with straight triangular rays. Figure solid black, bottle and droplets solid blue.

On a pure white background: a pictogram of a simplified black human figure sitting and resting under a large solid blue parasol shape that covers it completely. In the upper corner outside the parasol, a solid black sun symbol with straight triangular rays. Figure solid black, parasol solid blue. The background must be plain pure white, not dark, not black, not grey. Do not add any glow, halo, light rays, sky, ground, or scenery.

A pictogram of a simplified human figure staggering off balance, body leaning sideways, one hand raised to its head. Two large sweat droplet shapes fly off the head. The entire figure is solid bright red to signal overheating and danger. Beside the figure, one bold solid red exclamation mark shape. In the upper corner a small solid red sun symbol with straight triangular rays. Everything red on white, no black.

On a pure white background: a pictogram showing exactly two simplified human figures in clear side view. One figure lies flat on its back on the ground, drawn in solid red, its head clearly attached to its body. A second figure, drawn in solid black, kneels beside it holding a solid blue telephone handset to its ear. Nothing else in the image: no umbrella, no parasol, no sun, no ground line, no props. Both figures fully visible, side by side, not overlapping.
